credit.notes: 24x7 PhoneBanking. 1800 103 6000 applies to select Marquee/Raree credit cards. From outside India: +91 22 4935 0000. Block also available via YES Mobile / iris app card controls. National cybercrime helpline 1930 for online fraud.

debit.notes: Debit card cum ATM card lost/stolen: call PhoneBanking 1800 1200 (toll free) or 1860 210 1200 immediately. From outside India: +91 22 5079 5101 / 1833 800 0149 (USA) / 1833 491 0559 (Canada) / 8000 46 9153 (UK) / 8000 3570 2510 (UAE). Block also via NetBanking / YES Mobile.
